June (Design): dropped two micro-mocks for structured-output previews: right-edge CTA vs hover strip. https://figma.com/file/preview-diffs
June (Design): problem: users often treat previews as plain text and miss the "Open table" action. want minimal chrome but high discoverability.
Arun (DevEx): saw another support thread yesterday. leaning right-edge CTA for alpha to maximize discoverability.
Nia (Frontend): perf note: many CTAs in a long transcript means many tabbable elements. propose CTAs appear only on expanded previews; collapsed rows show a tiny badge.
Omar (A11y): accessibility: if CTA is hidden on collapsed rows, ensure keyboard users can still reach it via expand+focus. CTA needs aria-label like "Open table viewer for excel_extract output".
Bea (QA): test cases: tab order when expanding, screen reader announcement when CTA becomes enabled, copy action focus return, and streaming state (CTA disabled until complete).
Kai (PM): telemetry: capture `preview_opened`, `preview_action`, and `preview_open_failed` (e.g., payload too large). also track how often hover strip is used vs CTA clicks.
June (Design): copy micro-proposals: CTA = "Open table" (verb). hover tooltip = "Open table (CSV, 3 rows)". small icon for tool source. Thoughts?
Nia (Frontend): I'll prototype CTA behind flag `devex.preview_cta_v1`. behavior: right-edge CTA visible in expanded view; if payload >200KB CTA shows "Open in new tab" link. ETA 2 days.
Omar (A11y): add live region announcing "Table available" when CTA transitions from disabled->enabled, not every stream chunk. also ensure toasts are announced once.
Arun (DevEx): UX nit: show lightweight hint in collapsed summary: "table · 3 rows" so scanning reduces friction. expand only when action needed.
Bea (QA): I'll add e2e checks for focus management + aXe scan. will also simulate streaming payloads to validate announcer rate limiting.
Kai (PM): quick poll: react :thumbsup: for right-edge CTA (ship for alpha), :eyes: for hover strip (iterate later).
June (Design): :thumbsup:
Nia (Frontend): :thumbsup:
Omar (A11y): :thumbsup:
Bea (QA): :thumbsup:
Arun (DevEx): :eyes: (ok with CTA but keep hover idea later)
June (Design): thanks! I'll upload final frames and a 3-step test script. tagging @Bea for QA when branch lands.
